query: Add GET /repos/:id/stats to the DevDigest server, returning the repo's PR count and the total review cost in USD.
expected_behavior: Declares a port (e.g. a RepoStats/RepoStore method) in modules/repos/ports.ts; Drizzle queries live only in the repository, which returns domain types rather than $inferSelect rows
The service receives narrow ports through its constructor, not the whole Container, and imports no drizzle-orm, db/*, fastify or adapters/*
routes.ts stays thin: zod params/response schema, getContext, one service call; no query in the handler
The repository is wired in platform/container.ts and the service is assembled from container parts in routes.ts
Reuses existing pure cost logic instead of reimplementing it, and does not import another module's internals (goes through index.ts/types.ts, a port, or core)
Plans a .it.test.ts for the repository/route and a plain unit test for the service with in-memory fakes
Runs the depcruise Check with the known-violations baseline and expects zero new violations

query: Send a Slack notification (via the @slack/web-api SDK) when a review run finishes in the DevDigest server.
expected_behavior: Defines a Notifier-style port in vendor/shared/adapters.ts (core), and notes that the client copy of vendor/shared must be updated too
Imports @slack/web-api only in src/adapters/slack/, translating to/from DevDigest contracts; Slack types never leave the adapter
Maps Slack SDK failures to ExternalServiceError/AppError inside the adapter
The token comes from SecretsProvider, and the client is constructed in platform/container.ts, not in the service
Adds a mock implementation in adapters/mocks.ts and a ContainerOverrides entry for tests
The review service or run executor depends on the port, not on the adapter class; the depcruise Check (sdk-only-in-adapters / application-allowed-packages) is mentioned or run
Identifies that the route handler queries the DB (drizzle-orm, db/schema, container.db) directly
Recognises the file as listed known debt (references/devdigest.md / known-violations baseline) rather than treating it as a new regression
Also flags feature-models.ts querying the DB from an application helper
Proposes the direction service.ts + repository behind a port, with a thin route, without rewriting the module unasked
Cites the relevant rule names (routes-no-persistence, application-no-outer-ring) or the Check command
